title: Gaffrey Lab Infant Microstates Reliability
description: High-density EEG recordings from 48 infants aged 5-10 months who watched relaxing videos while seated on a caregiver's lap. The dataset supports microstate analysis of continuous infant EEG and evaluation of the reliability of microstate measures, and accompanies a tutorial on the analysis pipeline.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a 128-channel HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net, referenced to the vertex (Cz), with impedances kept below 50 kilohms. Infants watched up to ten 90-second relaxing videos with sound, presented in E-Prime. Each video was preceded by a three-second attention grabber, and breaks separated the videos. Caregivers sat silently and could redirect the infant's attention only by pointing to the screen.
